Question ID: Q016
Question: Count work orders by status.
raw_response:
1. ```sql
SELECT
  wo.status,
  COUNT(*) AS work_order_count
FROM work_orders AS wo
GROUP BY wo.status
ORDER BY wo.status;
```

2. ```sql
SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM work_orders
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;
```

3. ```sql
SELECT
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS total_work_orders
FROM work_orders
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, status;
```
